title: City station readings (hourly), Environment Monitoring Unit
summary: Hourly NO2 and PM2.5 concentrations (ug/m3) from the city's own monitoring stations, keyed by station code and UTC hour start (ts_utc). Catalog states coverage from 2023-01-01 with no end date, hourly refresh and about 4.2 million rows. It is the only internal hourly NO2/PM2.5 source, and it does not cover the 2004-2005 prototype window. Access is by request to the Environment Monitoring Unit, and no sample was read, so the content is unverified.

quality_notes: Station VR-03 (Via Roma) stopped reporting on 2024-06-30 (wiki station_network, last_edited 2024-07-01). The catalog entry (exported 2026-10-14) does not mention this, and the wiki says the catalog lists the network as active. Any production-window analysis must handle a station that ends 6 months into the 2024-2025 window.
Wiki station_network (2024-07-01) says the other stations report continuously from 2023-01-01. This claim is over two years old and has not been checked against the data, which was not accessible.
Catalog says refresh_cadence hourly and last_refreshed 2026-10-14. The wiki does not confirm either.
No validated vs provisional flag column is documented, so it is unknown whether the values are quality-assured.
No missing-value code (for example -200 or -999) is documented in the catalog or the wiki. The catalog has no has_missing_values declaration. Missingness cannot be assessed.
Station coordinates and district are not in the catalog, so traffic (N2) and clinic district (N4) joins are not possible from this source alone.
Coverage starts 2023-01-01, so it cannot serve the prototype window (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04) (N1 prototype).
No sample was read, because access is by request. Data types and value ranges are as documented only.

provenance.claim: Catalog entry: owner Environment Monitoring Unit, status active, classification internal, grain hourly, temporal_coverage 2023-01-01 to null, refresh hourly, last_refreshed 2026-10-14, ~4.2M rows, access method warehouse_sql via request.
Columns station_id, ts_utc (UTC hour start), no2_ugm3 and pm25_ugm3 (ug/m3); no validation flag or coordinates in column list.
Station VR-03 switched off 2024-06-30; catalog still lists network active; other stations continuous from 2023-01-01 (last_edited 2024-07-01).
The only wiki backlink to the entry is station_network.
